## Purpose

Describe the learning or workflow problem addressed and how success is measured.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Relevant calculations and import boundaries have regression coverage
- [ ] Examples are synthetic or fully redacted
- [ ] No credentials, account data, generated builds, or secure assessment material added

## Product boundary

- [ ] No live signals, brokerage authentication, order execution, or outcome promises
- [ ] Provider identity, timestamps, limitations, and educational framing remain visible
